summary.headline: Bergamo Codex: Ptolemy Manuscript
summary.text: Description of Bergamo Municipal Library codex Δ, 5, 13, a sixteenth-century paper manuscript of Claudius Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos with book tables, marginal variant readings, and a corrected copy of the Fruit in 100 chapters; it cross-references codex Flor. 3, folio 19v.
